compare.indexSeoDesc: Compare 2MC Gastro with GGM Gastro, Nisbets and BigGastro. Price, product range, 3D design, installation service and more.

compare.detailSeoTitle: 2MC Gastro vs {{name}} — Which is Better? (2026 Comparison)
compare.detailSeoDesc: Compare {{name}} and 2MC Gastro side by side: product count, 3D design, installation, pricing and more. Which one is right for you?
compare.faqPriceA: 2MC Gastro sits in the mid-market price segment. {{name}} is positioned in the {{pricing}} segment. 2MC Gastro balances any price difference with turnkey installation, 3D design and HACCP consulting.
compare.faqDesignAYes: Yes, {{name}} offers a limited 3D design tool. 2MC Gastro provides a full-featured free 3D studio — drag & drop, real-time bill of materials and PDF quote export.
compare.faqDesignANo: No, {{name}} does not offer a 3D design tool. 2MC Gastro provides a free 3D kitchen studio, real-time BOM and a HACCP-compliant layout plan.
compare.faqInstallQ: Is installation included when I buy from {{name}}?
compare.faqInstallAYes: {{name}} offers installation in selected regions. 2MC Gastro provides a full turnkey solution across Europe — delivery, installation, training and service warranty.
compare.faqInstallANo: {{name}} typically only sells products; installation is left to the customer. 2MC Gastro offers a full turnkey service including delivery, installation, training and service warranty.
compare.faqTurkishQ: Which platform is better suited to Turkish businesses?
compare.faqTurkishA: 2MC Gastro is optimized for Turkish businesses with a Turkish-language interface, a Turkish sales team and financing options tailored to Turkey. {{name}} does not offer dedicated support for the Turkish market.
compare.faqAiQ: Does {{name}} have an AI sales assistant?
compare.faqAiA: No. 2MC Gastro is the only platform in the market with an AI sales assistant that provides product recommendations personalized to your business type and capacity.
compare.faqVarietyQ: Which platform has a broader product range?
compare.faqVarietyA: {{name}} lists {{count}}+ products. 2MC Gastro offers a focused catalog of 10,000+ premium products — with Diamond and CombiSteel as flagship brands. Curated, proven equipment rather than a sprawling catalog.
compare.detailIntro: Compare the two platforms side by side — price, products, service and technology. Which one is the right choice for your business?

tools.calcFaq1A: It depends on the segment: ~0.45 m² per guest for a restaurant, 0.55 m² for a hotel, 0.70 m² for catering. This calculator gives you a tailored estimate.
